title: Concept: HTTPS registry traffic tunnelled through a cleartext proxy URL
description: .npmrc declares an `https-proxy` setting that itself uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The CONNECT tunnel is set up over an unprotected hop, so the proxy identity is unverified and the path can be redirected.
risk: The CONNECT tunnel is set up over an unprotected hop, so the proxy identity is unverified and the path can be redirected.
